title: HDL test
definition: HDL stands for high-density lipoprotein, which carries cholesterol through the blood.
what_it_measures: An HDL cholesterol result represents the level of cholesterol carried by HDL in the blood.
general_information: HDL collects cholesterol from the blood and transports it to the liver, which removes it from the body. This role is why HDL cholesterol is often called 'good' cholesterol.

source.title: LDL and HDL Cholesterol and Triglycerides
